encoding.field: 964 x 406 PNG, value = DN x step, DN 255 = no data
encoding.series: uint16 little-endian [6374 steps][SM, LGBM, DNN, CODE] per land cell, 65535 = no value, value = raw x series_scale; raw sigma = LGBM where CODE bit 16 is set

archives.daily: daily/TCA_{VAR}_{YYYY}.pmtiles  z10/x=step index within the year/y0  (VAR: SM, LGBM, DNN, CODE)
archives.monthly: monthly/TCA_{VAR}_monthly.pmtiles  z9/x=(year-2015)*12+month-1/y0  (SM, ERR, LGBM, DNN, NSM, PRAW, PREC, PMISS)
archives.clim: clim/TCA_{VAR}_clim.pmtiles  z9/x=0 record, 1..12 calendar month/y0  (+ SDERR, SDLGBM at x=0)

steps.note: step index = 2 x (day index) + (0 for the 6 a.m. descending overpass, 1 for the 6 p.m. ascending one); each file's time axis starts at the year's first step (2015: 20 Feb; 2023: 1 Jan ... 11 Nov)

source.format: NetCDF-4, float32, contiguous; dimensions latitude x longitude x time; no time coordinate
source.input: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 36 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture (SPL3SMP v9), AM and PM, no quality screening; ASCAT H SAF CDR v7; GLDAS Noah 0.25 deg 3-hourly
